item.goblinraiders.teleport_amulet.lore: Goblins use it to vanish with their loot after a raid
item.goblinraiders.teleport_amulet.targe: Not bound: takes you to your bed or spawn point
item.goblinraiders.teleport_amulet.hint: Hold use to teleport, sneak + use on a block to bind
item.goblinraiders.teleport_amulet.nowhe: The amulet finds no safe place to take you
goblinraiders.note.text:
Hey you!

We took everything from your chests. Nice stuff, we like it!

Want it back? Come and get it:
X: %s   Z: %s

If you dare...

                 - The Goblins
goblinraiders.note.blank: The note is smeared with mud. Nothing can be read.
block.goblinraiders.goblin_stash.more: There is more stolen loot here - make room and open the stash again
goblinraiders.raid.message: It seems you have uninvited guests at your base...
commands.goblinraid.trigger.success: Goblins raided %s: %s stacks from %s chests, carried to the village at X %s, Z %s
commands.goblinraid.trigger.no_base: %s has no base yet: chests and barrels count once the player places or opens them
commands.goblinraid.trigger.no_village: No goblin village found near the base of %s
commands.goblinraid.trigger.nothing_to_s: The chests of %s are empty, nothing to steal
commands.goblinraid.trigger.too_close: %s is too close to the base
commands.goblinraid.info: %s: %s tracked chests, main base of %s chests around %s %s %s, raids so far: %s, next raid possible in %s s
goblinraiders.speech.small.idle.2: Hee-hee, nobody saw me nick that boot!
goblinraiders.speech.small.idle.4: My ear itches. Someone's talking about me.
goblinraiders.speech.small.idle.5: When I grow up I'll be a giant!
goblinraiders.speech.small.idle.6: Who touched my pile of pebbles?!
goblinraiders.speech.small.taunt.1: Can't catch me, can't catch me!
goblinraiders.speech.small.taunt.3: You stomp like a giant after lunch!
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.idle.1: The sword needs sharpening. Or someone to use it on.
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.idle.2: Boring. We haven't robbed anyone in ages.
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.idle.3: One more notch on the hilt and it's forty.
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.idle.4: Whoever makes noise loses their ears.
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.idle.5: Good steel. Took it from the smith myself.
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.taunt.4: Weakling! Even the little ones hit harder!
goblinraiders.speech.ruthless.taunt.5: I'll take you apart for chest planks!
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.idle.1: A fine day for doing nothing.
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.idle.2: The giant ate all the mushrooms again...
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.idle.3: I left my spoon around here somewhere.
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.idle.5: Leave me be and I'll leave you be.
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.idle.6: I wonder if humans save coins too.
goblinraiders.speech.neutral.taunt.1: Go away while I'm still nice!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.1: The rocks are talking! They say "crunch"!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.2: I ate a mushroom. Or did it eat me? Hee-hee-hee!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.3: The moon is a giant coin! I'll get it!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.4: Boo! Ha-ha-ha! Scared? No? I am!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.6: Shh... the chicken is watching us.
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.idle.7: I counted to ten. Got seven!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.battle.1: Yay! A new friend! Let's fight!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.taunt.3: I'm invisible! You can't see me!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.taunt.5: Mom said no biting. Mom is far away!
goblinraiders.speech.crazy.taunt.6: Grab my ear if you can!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.idle.1: Fine goods, hardly stolen at all!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.idle.2: Coins, coins... they jingle like a song.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.idle.5: New stock! Well, new to me.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.battle.1: That's it, the haggling is over!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.taunt.2: Beatings are a hundred percent off!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.taunt.3: You should have just bought the sword!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.yell.1: WHAT?! Do you know how far I hauled this junk?!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.yell.3: Refuse ME?! The best trader for a hundred chunks?!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.yell.4: You cheapskate! Now you're in for it!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.go_away.1: Get lost! I don't trade with rude folk!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.go_away.3: Don't even look at my goods!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.thanks.2: Heh, a good deal. For me.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.thanks.4: Just don't tell anyone where you got it.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.calm.2: Phew. All right, you're forgiven. Almost.
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.1: Ah, youngsters... In my day we robbed politely.
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.2: Old bones ache before the rain.
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.3: I remember when this palisade went up...
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.4: If only someone listened to an old goblin...
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.5: Heh... it's been long since I told stories by the fire.
goblinraiders.speech.elder.idle.6: My staff was around here. Or was it a stick?
goblinraiders.speech.elder.help.1: Ow! Help, they're hurting an old goblin!
goblinraiders.chat.1.1: Heard? The giant ate a cauldron again.
goblinraiders.chat.2.1: Shall we rob some humans today?
goblinraiders.chat.2.3: They always have diamonds. They dig them up!
goblinraiders.chat.4.1: Why do humans put chests side by side?
goblinraiders.chat.4.2: To make it easier for us!
goblinraiders.chat.5.1: Seen the crazy one? He's talking to a chicken again.
goblinraiders.chat.6.1: How many coins have you got?
goblinraiders.chat.6.3: Just counting how many I'll have.
goblinraiders.chat.7.1: The trader raised his prices again.
goblinraiders.chat.7.3: That's exactly why he raised them!
goblinraiders.chat.8.1: The elder says goblins came from under the mountain.
goblinraiders.chat.8.2: I thought from under the bed.
goblinraiders.chat.10.2: Yeah! I took a whole pickaxe!
goblinraiders.chat.11.1: Quiet! I think a human is near.
goblinraiders.chat.12.1: Do you think the giant can count?
goblinraiders.chat.12.4: Ask him yourself if you dare.
goblinraiders.dialog.trader.greeting.1: Heh, a stranger! Come in, don't be shy. Coins jingling? Here are my prices:
goblinraiders.dialog.trader.greeting.2: Oh, a customer! A rare beast around here. Look at these goods:
goblinraiders.dialog.trader.greeting.3: Only the best for you! Well, almost the best. Honest goblin prices:
goblinraiders.dialog.trader.question: So, will you trade?
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.greeting.1: Ah, a traveller... Sit by the fire and listen to an old goblin. I've seen a lot in my two hundred winters.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.greeting.2: Heh, don't be afraid, I don't bite. Hardly any teeth left. What do you want to know?
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.greeting.3: Nobody has visited me in a long while. Humans usually come with swords, not questions.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.ask: What shall I tell you about?
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.goblins.1: Long ago, when the mountains were young, we lived beneath them, in warm caves by underground rivers. Dark, damp and full of mushrooms. Lovely!
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.goblins.2: But one day humans started digging mines. Pickaxes clanking, torches, noise. We went up and built villages from what we found. And we find anything that isn't nailed down.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.goblins.3: There are many kinds of us. The small ones are quick and nimble. The ruthless are warriors with swords. Giants are strength without wits. Ordinary goblins just live. And I am just old.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.raids.1: You ask why we raid? Silly question! Why do humans dig diamonds? Because they shine. And we love everything that shines, jingles and sits in chests.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.raids.2: We never raid while the owner is home. That's rude... and dangerous. We wait until they go far away, come quietly and leave a note. So they know where to look for their things.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.stash.1: Everything brought back from a raid goes into the chief's stash. It stands in the biggest house of the village. Open it and you'll find your stuff. If nobody notices you, of course.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.stash.2: An old goblin's advice: goblins don't like anyone touching the stash. Everyone nearby will jump at you. Bring a bigger sword. Or faster legs.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.amulet.1: Our shamans make teleportation amulets from ender pearls and swamp stone. Squeeze one in your paw and you are home, together with a sack of loot.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.amulet.2: A human can use an amulet too. Bind it to a place and it will bring you back there. Unbound, it takes you to your bed. Only you'll have to mend it with ender pearls.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.giants.1: Giants are our biggest brothers. They say a goblin once ate a whole cauldron of mushroom stew and grew to the roof. I believe it: I've seen how they eat.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.giants.2: A giant is slow, but one punch sends you over the palisade. Don't stand in front of him. And never, you hear me, never touch his cauldron.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.trade.1: We mint goblin coins from anything yellow we find. Sometimes it's gold. Sometimes not. But they all jingle just as nicely.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.trade.2: Some villages have traders. They'll sell you a goblin sword or armor for coins. Advice: don't turn a trader down rudely. They are very, very touchy.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.crazy.1: The crazy ones... sigh. They ate the wrong mushrooms in the dark forest. Now they run around, cackle and bite everything. Fast as the wind, but feeble.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.crazy.2: We don't chase them away. First, they're family. Second, nobody can catch them. If you hear mad laughter, keep your weapon ready.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.legend.1: They say the First Goblin was tiny and very greedy. He stole a silver coin from the Moon herself and hid it so well that he forgot where.
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.legend.2: Since then every goblin has been looking for that coin. In every chest, in every pocket. That's why we raid. It's not greed, it's tradition!
goblinraiders.dialog.elder.legend.3: And the Moon is still cross. See, every night she shines down on the land looking for her coin. Heh... Off you go now. Time for an old goblin's nap.
item.goblinraiders.concealment_amulet.de: Use: look like a goblin for %s s; goblins will not attack first
item.goblinraiders.concealment_amulet.lo: Strike a goblin or insult a trader and the disguise falls off
item.goblinraiders.king_scepter.desc: Use: call a goblin guard for a minute
item.goblinraiders.vassal_charter.desc: Token of the goblin king's horde. Tribute: %s coins every three days. Use to check when it is due
goblinraiders.disguise.on: You take on a goblin's shape...
goblinraiders.disguise.broken: The disguise falls off: the goblins see through you!
goblinraiders.raid.caravan: It seems you have uninvited guests at your base... Goblins are hauling your things %s - you can still catch them!
goblinraiders.caravan.share: You took back part of the loot!
goblinraiders.caravan.all: The caravan is beaten: all the loot is yours!
goblinraiders.caravan.arrived: The goblin caravan reached its village. Look for your things in the stash.
commands.goblinraid.trigger.vassal: %s is a vassal of the goblin king and is not raided
goblinraiders.horde.joined: You joined the goblin king's horde. Goblins will not attack you first and raids will stop. Tribute: %s coins every three days - the collector takes it from you himself.
goblinraiders.horde.collected: The king's tribute collector took %s coins.
goblinraiders.horde.overdue: Your tribute to the king is overdue! Carry %s coins, or in a day you will be thrown out of the horde.
goblinraiders.horde.expelled: You did not pay your tribute. The goblin king has thrown you out of the horde!
goblinraiders.horde.too_early: The king does not take tribute that far ahead.
goblinraiders.horde.dismissed: %s has served their time and left.
goblinraiders.horde.status: You are a vassal of the goblin king. Next tribute (%s coins) in %s
goblinraiders.horde.status_none: You are not in the goblin king's horde.
goblinraiders.king.not_now: The goblin king does not even notice your feeble blows. Talk to him first.
goblinraiders.dialog.king.greeting: You stand before the Goblin King, stranger! My subjects rob your chests, my giants break your walls. Bow your head and join my horde. Or die.
goblinraiders.dialog.king.terms: A vassal pays tribute: %s coins every three days. In return none of my goblins will attack you first, the raids on your base stop, and my warriors will serve you for coins.
goblinraiders.dialog.king.vassal: Ah, my loyal vassal. What do you want?
goblinraiders.dialog.king.overdue: Your tribute is overdue! Bring %s coins or leave my horde.
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.idle.2: The bones say: rain is coming. Or war.
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.idle.3: Where is my dried spider? I left it right here!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.idle.5: The moon is sour tonight. A bad sign.
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.idle.6: Heh-heh-heh... someone will turn green soon.
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.battle.1: I'll turn you into a toad!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.battle.2: I'll make soup out of you!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.battle.4: I curse you! I curse you!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.taunt.1: Croak! Oh, is that not you croaking yet?
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.taunt.2: My mushrooms are stronger than your sword!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.spell.2: Rotten log, morel cap, tie the legs in a knot!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.spell.3: Heave and splash, grease the bones!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.spell.4: Bubble-brew, a party for your head!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.spell.5: A crooked root is your lot!
goblinraiders.speech.shaman.spell.6: Swampy dark, a curse most stark!
goblinraiders.speech.king.idle.1: Everything in these lands is mine. Especially the shiny things.
goblinraiders.speech.king.idle.2: The crown is heavy... but how it shines!
goblinraiders.speech.king.idle.3: Where is my goblet? Who dared take my goblet?!
goblinraiders.speech.king.idle.4: The horde grows. Soon we will reach the human towns.
goblinraiders.speech.king.battle.4: I will crush you with my scepter!
goblinraiders.speech.king.taunt.3: Nobody has left the king alive!
goblinraiders.speech.king.challenge.3: Seize them! No wait... I'll do it myself.
goblinraiders.speech.king.submit.1: A wise choice. From now on you are my vassal.
goblinraiders.speech.king.submit.2: Bowed? Good. Pay on time and live.
goblinraiders.speech.king.submit.3: Welcome to the horde, little human.
goblinraiders.speech.king.tribute.2: A punctual vassal is a living vassal.
goblinraiders.speech.king.calm.1: Ran away... so be it. Kings do not run.

goblinraiders.speech.common.woken.5: Oh! A thief! Or not a thief?
goblinraiders.speech.common.morning.2: Oh, my back... who put rocks under my bedding?
goblinraiders.speech.common.alarm.1: Alarm! A stranger in the village!
goblinraiders.speech.common.watch.3: Everyone sleeps and I keep watch...
goblinraiders.speech.common.watch.4: The fire is warm and I am so sleepy...
goblinraiders.speech.common.watch.5: My eyes are closing... No! I'm on duty!
goblinraiders.speech.common.watch.6: If anyone asks, I didn't see a thing.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.woken.1: The shop is closed! Come back in the morning!
goblinraiders.speech.trader.woken.2: I don't trade at night! Well, maybe at double price... kidding.
goblinraiders.speech.trader.woken.3: Who wakes a trader at this hour?!
goblinraiders.speech.elder.woken.1: Oh... who's there? Ah, it's you. Old bones sleep badly.
goblinraiders.speech.elder.woken.2: Hmm? Stories in the morning, traveller.
goblinraiders.speech.king.traitor.2: You dared?! I will crush you!
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.greeting.1: Oh, a human! Come in peace? Then let us chat.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.greeting.2: What are you staring at? Ah, you want to talk. Go on then.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.greeting.3: Hello, hello! Just don't touch, I bite.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.greeting.4: Hmm. You don't look like a thief. Then again, nobody does.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.life.1: Life is fine. Mushrooms by day, sleep by night. A raid now and then, for variety.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.life.2: Hard! The trader fleeces everyone, and the elder keeps going on about the First Goblin...
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.life.3: We live well. A roof, a stew, humans with chests nearby - lovely!
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.life.4: I'm peaceful, actually. As long as nobody pokes me.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.life.5: I dream of becoming a trader. Sitting in a shop, coins jingling...
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.1: They say the king raised the tribute again. Good thing I'm no vassal.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.2: Yesterday our lot brought a whole barrel of potatoes from a raid. Who even needs potatoes?
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.3: The shaman brewed a new potion. Now Grykh has three ears.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.4: The crazy one ran around the fire all night again, yelling at the moon.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.5: A giant fell asleep on the storehouse roof. The roof gave up.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.news.6: They are building a new throne in the great village. The king sat the old one flat.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.tale.1: Once I stole a whole chest from a human. Opened it - dirt. Sixty-four blocks of dirt!
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.tale.2: My grandpa fought a creeper. Grandpa won. He just does not have a house any more.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.tale.3: Once a giant goblin decided to hide in a wardrobe. There is no wardrobe any more either.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.tale.4: Once upon a time there was a goblin who did not like gold. Kidding! No such goblin.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.tale.5: Once we robbed a human, and the human caught the caravan and took it all back. We still do not laugh about it.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.1: At night half of us are snoring. Sneak, and nobody wakes up. Just keep clear of the watchmen by the fires.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.2: If you got robbed, run after them! The goblins with sacks are slow and do not like fighting.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.3: The king cannot stand being hit before a word is said. Talk first, then see how it goes.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.4: If the shaman curses you, your arms go weak. Hit him first, while he is brewing his muck.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.5: The amulet of concealment makes you one of us. But hit anyone and the disguise falls off.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.advice.6: Do not fall out with the trader. He holds a grudge and yells so loud my ears wilt.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.thanks.1: Yum! Now that's grub! Listen, between you and me...
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.thanks.2: Oh, the taste of home! For this I will share a secret.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.thanks.3: Munch, munch... All right, I'll tell you, since you're so kind.
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.stash: Our stash is %s blocks to the %s. But you didn't hear it from me!
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.no_stash: A stash? What stash? We have no stash. Honest.
goblinraiders.dialog.king.betray_confirm: Betray the king? He never forgives that: you will be cast out of the horde for good, the raids on your base will resume, and the king will come at you right here. Your mercenaries stay with you.
goblinraiders.horde.betrayed: You betrayed the goblin king! The horde will never take you back, and the raids will resume.
goblinraiders.speech.child.idle.2: Mum, can I go on a raid too?
goblinraiders.speech.child.idle.3: I found a shiny! Not giving it back!
goblinraiders.speech.child.idle.5: When I grow up I'll be a giant!
goblinraiders.speech.child.work.2: When I grow up I'll only do raids!
goblinraiders.speech.child.work.4: The king says I must, so I must.
goblinraiders.speech.child.no_chest.1: Where do I put it? Get a chest!
goblinraiders.speech.child.no_chest.2: My pockets are full! I need a chest!
goblinraiders.speech.child.not_mine.1: There's no stone here, this isn't a mine!
goblinraiders.speech.child.not_mine.2: Take me to a real mine!
goblinraiders.speech.child.no_field.1: Where's the farm? Nothing grows here!
goblinraiders.speech.child.diamond.1: Oh! A diamond! A real one!
goblinraiders.speech.child.diamond.2: Shiny! Can I keep it? No? Fine...
goblinraiders.speech.child.woken.2: I dreamt of a huge chest...
goblinraiders.dialog.small.greeting.1: Oh, one of us! Which camp are you from? I am from that one.
goblinraiders.dialog.small.greeting.2: Shh! I am hiding from the ruthless one. What do you want?
goblinraiders.dialog.small.greeting.3: Hey, goblin brother! You look a bit pale today.
goblinraiders.dialog.ruthless.greeting.1: Hmph. You are not from my squad. Talk fast.
goblinraiders.dialog.ruthless.greeting.2: What are you staring at? The sword is not for sale.
goblinraiders.dialog.ruthless.greeting.3: One of us? Fine. But if you lie, you will regret it.
goblinraiders.dialog.giant.greeting.1: HM? LITTLE GOBLIN WANTS TO TALK?
goblinraiders.dialog.giant.greeting.3: You smell strange. But fine. Hello.
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.greeting.1: The spirits whispered you would come. Or it was the mushrooms.
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.greeting.2: Do not touch the cauldron! What do you want, brother?
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.greeting.3: Hmm... you smell of human. Have you been eating human food?
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.advice.1: Never drink a potion if you do not know who brewed it. Especially if it was me.
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.advice.2: Heal the giants fast: they fall slowly, but grumble for ages.
goblinraiders.dialog.shaman.advice.3: A curse wears off by itself. After twenty breaths. Or was it out-breaths. I forget.
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.greeting.1: HEE-HEE! Do you also hear the grass singing?
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.greeting.2: I am a cloud! And you? Also a cloud?
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.life.1: Life? Life is round! Like a coin! Or a face!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.life.2: Yesterday I ran around the fire a hundred times. Or once. It was a long one.
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.life.3: Wonderful! A beetle lives in my head!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.news.1: The moon is square tonight! Nobody believes me!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.news.2: A giant ate my shadow! Now I have none!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.news.3: News: I made up a new word. Boombyrdysh!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.tale.1: There once was a goblin. Then he became a chicken. The end!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.tale.2: Once I stole a human from a human! Kidding. Or not.
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.tale.3: I was friends with a creeper. He had a short temper.
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.advice.1: Never eat glowing mushrooms. Well, only on Tuesdays.
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.advice.2: Yell at the moon long enough and it will answer!
goblinraiders.dialog.crazy.advice.3: Run in circles. Always. Nobody will catch you. Not even yourself.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.greeting.1: Oh, who are you? Are you big or small?
goblinraiders.dialog.child.greeting.2: Hi! Want to see my shiny?
goblinraiders.dialog.child.greeting.3: Mum says I shouldn't talk to strangers... But you look funny!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.greeting.4: Did you bring a sweet? No? Shame.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.life.1: Fun! I run around all day, and at night Mum calls me to bed.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.life.2: Boring. The grown-ups go raiding and never take me.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.life.3: Good! I had a fight today and won! Almost.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.news.1: A giant let me sit on his shoulder!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.news.2: The shaman said if I misbehave he will turn me into a toad!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.news.3: I saw the king! His crown is SO SHINY!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.tale.1: Once there was a goblin kid who ate a whole chest of sweets. It was me!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.tale.2: Granny told me about the First Goblin. He was small, like me!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.tale.3: Once I hid in a chest and got carried off on a raid! It was dark.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.advice.1: If you break something, say the crazy one did it.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.advice.2: Never tug a giant by the leg. Never.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.advice.3: Mud is tasty. But don't tell Mum.
goblinraiders.dialog.child.thanks.1: Yay, grub! Oh, do you know where our stash is? I do!
goblinraiders.dialog.child.thanks.2: Yummy! Here is a secret for that!
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.following: I follow you. Say "Work here" when we get there.
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.working.farm: I work the fields here: harvest, replant and carry everything to the chest.
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.working.mine: I dig in the mine here and carry the haul to the chest. The deeper the mine, the better the ore.
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.problem.no_c: There is no chest nearby - nowhere to put things!
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.problem.not_: There is no stone around - this is not a mine.
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.problem.no_f: There are no fields or crops here.
goblinraiders.dialog.worker.problem.full: My pockets are full and there is no chest!
goblinraiders.dialog.king.buy_farmer.tip: Buy a goblin child to work your fields
goblinraiders.dialog.king.buy_miner.tip: Buy a goblin child to dig in your mine
goblinraiders.horde.worker_farmer: A goblin farmer child works for you now. Bring it to your fields near a chest, click it and say "Work here".
goblinraiders.horde.worker_miner: A goblin miner child works for you now. Bring it to your mine near a chest, click it and say "Work here".
advancements.goblinraiders.undercover.de: Chat with a goblin that took you for one of its own
advancements.goblinraiders.artel.title: Goblin Workforce
advancements.goblinraiders.artel.descrip: Buy a goblin child worker from the king
advancements.goblinraiders.harvest.title: First Harvest
advancements.goblinraiders.harvest.descr: A goblin farmer child brought the harvest to a chest
advancements.goblinraiders.haul.title: Mining Shift
advancements.goblinraiders.haul.descript: A goblin miner child brought its haul to a chest
advancements.goblinraiders.diamond.title: Little Diamond Hands
advancements.goblinraiders.diamond.descr: A goblin miner child found a diamond
goblinraiders.hamlet.house_built: The goblins finished building: %s. A new family moved into the village!
goblinraiders.sage.tired: The spirits have already spoken to me today. Come back tomorrow, traveller.
goblinraiders.sage.vision: The sage closes his eyes... the campfire smoke forms pictures...
goblinraiders.sage.vision.hamlet: A peaceful goblin village lies to the %s, %s steps away.
goblinraiders.sage.vision.hamlet.none: The spirits see no peaceful villages nearby.
goblinraiders.sage.vision.den: A den of goblin raiders lies to the %s, %s steps away. Mind your chests!
goblinraiders.sage.vision.den.none: No raiders' dens nearby. For now.
goblinraiders.sage.vision.capital: The goblin king sits on his throne to the %s, %s steps away.
goblinraiders.sage.vision.capital.none: The king's throne lies far beyond my visions.
goblinraiders.sage.no_coins: A blessing costs %s coins. The spirits do not work for free.
goblinraiders.sage.blessed: May the forest spirits keep you, traveller. Luck is with you.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.prophecy_wait: The sage stares into the fire and whispers... The answer will come in the chat.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.blessing_wait: The sage raises his hands to the sky...
goblinraiders.speech.villager.idle.2: Oh, if only we had one more garden...
goblinraiders.speech.villager.idle.3: We are not like the ones in the woods. We live honestly here.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.idle.5: There will be stew by the fire tonight!
goblinraiders.speech.villager.idle.6: The village grows - the heart rejoices.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.help.3: What for?! I didn't do anything to you!
goblinraiders.speech.villager.thanks.2: An honest deal is the best deal.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.work.1: Work is not a wolf, it will not run away...
goblinraiders.speech.villager.no_chest.1: Where do I put all this?
goblinraiders.speech.villager.no_trees.1: All the trees are cut... waiting for them to grow.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.no_kitchen: You cannot cook without a fire.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.no_food.1: The pantry is empty... nothing to cook.
goblinraiders.speech.villager.no_wood.1: Out of logs! Lumberjack, where are you?
goblinraiders.speech.villager.built.2: Now that is a house! A sight to see!
goblinraiders.speech.lumberjack.idle.1: The forest loves silence. And an axe.
goblinraiders.speech.lumberjack.idle.2: Cut a tree, plant two. Well, one.
goblinraiders.speech.miner.idle.2: Rock is alive, you have to listen to it.
goblinraiders.speech.miner.idle.3: There's a diamond around here, I can feel it!
goblinraiders.speech.miner.work.3: Another load of rock going up.
goblinraiders.speech.builder.idle.1: One more house would fit here...
goblinraiders.speech.builder.idle.2: A crooked corner makes a crooked life.
goblinraiders.speech.builder.work.3: The walls stand, the roof is coming!
goblinraiders.speech.cook.idle.2: A pinch of mushrooms and you will lick your fingers.
goblinraiders.speech.cook.idle.3: Keep your hands out of the pot!
goblinraiders.speech.sage.idle.1: The fire speaks... the wind listens...
goblinraiders.speech.sage.idle.2: Every road leads to a campfire.
goblinraiders.speech.sage.help.1: Violence is the path of fools.
goblinraiders.speech.sage.help.2: Pff! I am not that easy to catch.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.greeting.1: Welcome to our village! It is quiet and peaceful here.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.greeting.2: Oh, a guest! Do not be afraid, we are not those goblins.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.greeting.3: Hello, traveller! Come in, let us talk.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.greeting.4: Hi! Just don't trample the beds.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.life.1: We live by our own work. We rob nobody and sleep soundly.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.life.2: We live well! Everyone has a job, and in the evening we sit by the fire.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.life.3: It can be hard, but what is yours is yours.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.life.4: We left the king. We don't want to fight, we want to build.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.news.1: The builders started a new house! Another family will move in soon.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.news.2: Yesterday the lumberjack nearly dropped a tree on the cook.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.news.3: The miner found a shiny stone in the tunnel. Says it is a diamond.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.news.4: They say a sage lives in the woods. He knows where everything is.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.news.5: A raiders' caravan passed by again. We hid.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.tale.1: Our grandpa was a ruthless goblin. Then he planted a garden and got kind.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.tale.2: Once the king sent a tribute collector. We fed him until he fell asleep.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.tale.3: The first house was built by the whole family. The roof came out crooked, but it was ours.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.tale.4: There once was a goblin who could not steal. They threw him out of the camp, and he founded our village.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.advice.1: Put logs and stone into the builders' chest and they will finish sooner.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.advice.2: Want a building of your own? Buy a building site from our builder and put it near us.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.advice.3: The cook always has grub. Cheap!
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.advice.4: At night we sleep and the watch sits by the fire. Keep it down.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.advice.5: Coins? Sell us something. The farmer buys bone meal, the cook buys rotten flesh.
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.thanks.1: Oh, grub! Just like mum's! Listen, I'll tell you a secret...
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.thanks.2: Thank you, traveller. Here is a tip for that...
goblinraiders.dialog.villager.thanks.3: Tasty! All right, since you are so generous...
goblinraiders.dialog.farmer.greeting.1: Hi! Have you seen the carrots this year?
goblinraiders.dialog.farmer.greeting.2: Hello! Do not step on the bed, I beg you.
goblinraiders.dialog.lumberjack.greeting: Oh, a guest! Step away from the tree or it will fall on you.
Hi! Need logs? I have some.
goblinraiders.dialog.miner.greeting.1: Shh... hear the rock sing? No? Never mind. Hi.
goblinraiders.dialog.miner.greeting.2: Hey! Need ore? Fresh from the tunnel.
goblinraiders.dialog.builder.greeting.1: Hello! Do not stand under the scaffolding, a log may fall on you.
goblinraiders.dialog.builder.greeting.2: Hi! Want us to build you a house too?
goblinraiders.dialog.cook.greeting.1: Hungry? I can see it in your eyes!
goblinraiders.dialog.cook.greeting.2: Come in, come in! The stew is almost ready.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.greeting.1: I have been expecting you, traveller. The fire told me you would come.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.greeting.2: Sit by the fire. Wisdom does not like haste.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.greeting.3: Few find the way to my tent. So you needed to.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.1: A goblin who counts other people's chests will never fill his own.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.2: Kings come and go, but the garden stays.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.3: A tree planted today will give shade to your grandchildren.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.4: Not everyone in a crown is a king. Not everyone in rags is a beggar.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.5: The quieter you walk, the more you hear. Especially at night by someone else's stash.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.6: One coin in the pocket rings louder than ten in dreams.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.7: Who betrayed once will find no shelter by the throne.
goblinraiders.dialog.sage.wisdom.8: Even a giant was once a goblin child.
advancements.goblinraiders.hamlet.title: Peaceful Neighbours
advancements.goblinraiders.new_house.des: See goblins finish a new building
advancements.goblinraiders.sage.title: The Hermit
advancements.goblinraiders.sage.descript: Find the goblin sage in his tent and talk to him
goblinraiders.dialog.neutral.treat.tip: Offer goblin grub: in thanks it tells you where the stash is
goblinraiders.speech.headman.idle.1: So much work, so few hands...
goblinraiders.speech.headman.idle.2: A full storehouse, a fed village.
goblinraiders.speech.headman.idle.4: Right, what's on the list today...
goblinraiders.speech.headman.help.1: Guards! Oh right, we have no guards...
goblinraiders.speech.headman.help.2: I am the headman, not a target!
goblinraiders.speech.headman.give.1: Here's your errand. Don't let me down!
goblinraiders.speech.headman.give.2: Get it done and you will not regret it.
goblinraiders.speech.headman.give.3: The village is counting on you.
goblinraiders.speech.headman.thanks.1: Excellent! Here is what you earned.
goblinraiders.speech.headman.thanks.2: Now that is what I call a helper!
goblinraiders.speech.headman.sigh.1: Oh well... I will find someone else.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.greeting.1: Hello, traveller! I am the headman of this village. We can always use some help.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.greeting.2: Ah, a guest! See the board? There is work enough for everyone.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.greeting.3: Welcome! Help the village and the village will help you.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.offer: Will you take an errand? I pay in goblin coins.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.completed: You have helped the village %s times already.
goblinraiders.dialog.headman.reward: Reward: %s coins and a bowl of grub.
goblinraiders.quest.logs.title: Logs for the builders
goblinraiders.quest.logs.text: The builders are short of wood. Bring %s logs and I will put them in the storehouse.
goblinraiders.quest.cobblestone.title: Stone for the walls
goblinraiders.quest.cobblestone.text: We need cobblestone for the new houses: %s of it.
goblinraiders.quest.wheat.title: Bread for the winter
goblinraiders.quest.wheat.text: The farmers cannot keep up. Bring %s wheat.
goblinraiders.quest.iron.title: Iron for tools
goblinraiders.quest.iron.text: Picks get blunt, axes break. We need %s iron ingots.
goblinraiders.quest.coal.title: Coal for the ovens
goblinraiders.quest.coal.text: The cook has nothing to burn. Bring %s coal.
goblinraiders.quest.zombies.title: Dead men at the edge
goblinraiders.quest.zombies.text: Zombies come to the village at night. Put %s of them to rest.
goblinraiders.quest.skeletons.title: Bony archers
goblinraiders.quest.skeletons.text: Skeletons shoot at our farmers. Smash %s of them.
goblinraiders.quest.spiders.title: A nest of spiders
goblinraiders.quest.spiders.text: Spiders have webbed the woods. Kill %s.
goblinraiders.quest.raiders.title: Raiders
goblinraiders.quest.raiders.text: Raider goblins rob everybody. Teach %s of them a lesson.
goblinraiders.quest.sage.title: The sage's counsel
goblinraiders.quest.sage.text: Somewhere out in the wild a sage lives in a tent. Find him and talk to him.
goblinraiders.quest.den.title: Scouting
goblinraiders.quest.den.text: Find out where the raiders' den is: walk into any of their villages and come back alive.
goblinraiders.quest.caravan.title: Interception
goblinraiders.quest.caravan.text: The raiders will haul their loot. Intercept their caravan: defeat a goblin carrying a sack.
goblinraiders.quest.done: Errand "%s" done! Go back to the headman.
advancements.goblinraiders.quest.title: Errand Done
advancements.goblinraiders.quest.descrip: Complete an errand for the headman of a peaceful village
advancements.goblinraiders.war_drums.des: Hear the war drums of a goblin camp
